brief: The canvas displays a continuous, intricate tessellation of interlocking hexagonal shapes. These connected cells are constantly in motion, rotating independently and exhibiting variable rates of speed across the surface, creating a deeply dynamic and mesmeric pattern. The overall color scheme adopts a vibrant, stylized palette inspired by 1980s aesthetics. The movement and interlocking geometry persist and flow continuously, without requiring any input or interaction from the viewer.

statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing tessellation of rotating hexagonal cells that flow continuously across the canvas. Each hexagon moves independently with its own rotation speed and direction, creating an intricate pattern of interlocking geometry that pulses and shifts without any user interaction. The vibrant 1980s-inspired color palette enhances the dynamic motion, making the entire composition feel alive and ever-changing.
